description: This file contains LDAP API functions for authentication, including connecting to an LDAP server, binding, search, and retrieving attribute values, tailored for the TestLink project.

methods.name: ldap_connect_bind
methods.description: Establishes and binds an LDAP connection using provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: ldap_authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user against the LDAP directory by searching for their DN and attempting to bind with provided credentials.

methods.name: ldap_escape_string
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LDAP strings to prevent injection attacks.

methods.name: ldap_get_field_from_username
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified LDAP attribute for a given username.
